reason: No auto-charge on the trial is the one thing that gets me to install it, so I'd run the 14 days for free. But I already fall asleep to free YouTube ASMR with my AirPods, so unless the comparison shows a big difference I'll just stay on the free version like I do with every app.
objection: I'm not convinced a phone on the bed can tell when I actually fell asleep, so the 'proof' at day 14 could be shaky. And getting a refund through Apple's request screen is never as easy as they make it sound.
would_change_my_mind: If on day 14 my own records showed I fell asleep clearly faster, like 10+ minutes sooner on the SLEEP:ON nights, I'd pay the monthly 4,900 for a month to see if it holds.
